findings.description: The match check changed from re.match to fullmatch, a behavior change the commit title does not mention.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match='foo') with an exception whose str is 'foo bar'. Before, self.match.match() anchors at the start and succeeds, so the retry happens. Now fullmatch requires the whole message to match, so it returns False and the retry is silently skipped. Users with prefix-style patterns see retries stop without any error.
